title: 这味道简直是人间仅有我的西瓜炒饭值这个价格
content_zh:
这味道，简直是人间仅有！
饭堂内。
看到老秃驴端着一只大西瓜上来，正在喝茶的少年，杏眼一瞪，“噗——”随即，一口茶喷出，喷了对面的陆百万一脸。
陆百万白着眼睛呆了呆，然后用袖子抹去脸上的茶水。
而这会，老秃驴已经把西瓜给放于饭桌上了。
看到只有一只西瓜，以及一双筷子和一只调羹，陆百万的脸色当即黑掉，黑线冒出，有种被耍的感觉，抬眸望向老秃驴，斥道：“你搬个西瓜出来作甚？”
老秃驴回道：“是小唐姑娘吩咐的！”
还不知情况的陆百万，气得脸色青一块白一块，命令老秃驴，“去，把那臭丫头给我叫出来，岂有此理！”
“别啊，”少年阻止了陆百万的命令，面向那老秃驴，“说说看，为何捧只西瓜上桌？不知道小爷我要吃的是有酒有果子味的炒饭吗？你们这是何意思呀？”
先前小唐姑娘叮嘱过，西瓜一上桌，定会被骂得体无完肤。老秃驴现在想想，心中不禁佩服起唐琳能预知等下发生的事情。
依照唐琳所吩咐的，老秃驴挺直腰板，把最精神的一面展示出现，对陆百万和少年解释道：“老板，这位客人点的饭菜，已经端上来了，就是这只西瓜！”
陆百万又一脸黑线，恨不得起身过来抡老秃驴一掌，“你看看，这是客人要的饭菜吗？你不认识这是西瓜吗？”
“老板，您误会了！”老秃驴不怕死地嘻嘻一笑，然后弯腰下去，把西瓜盖
那团让人食欲大增的香味，立即吸引了所有人的视线，都凑到饭桌围观。
小胖看着西瓜内丰富的炒饭，咂咂嘴巴，已经馋得流口水，双手更是不安分地搓在了一起，被眼前的美食所诱，“看着就不错了，尝起来一点很好吃！”
大家的嘴巴和双手都在蠢蠢欲动，包刮陆百万本人，
就在这时，少年灵活的双手，在陆百万伸出手的时候，她把端盘挪到自己面前，拿起筷子和调羹，开始往西瓜中掠食。
接下来，看着少年狼吞虎咽，似乎永远吃不饱的过瘾相，除了老秃驴，陆百万和他的几个伙计们，都垂涎欲滴。
一会儿的功夫，整只西瓜内的饭菜都已不见了，少年不满足地抬头望向老秃驴，问：“还有吗？”
“呃，”老秃驴一愣，反应回来后，问道：“客官对这份饭菜是否满意？”

少年一拍饭桌竖起大拇指，“满意，非常的满意，小爷我不仅吃到了色香味俱全的炒饭，还见识了用西瓜来装炒饭的，这样一来，所有的味道，都不会流失，而且炒饭混合西瓜味，这味道……嗯……简直是人间仅有！”
能得到少年这番称赞，唐琳的身价，一下子在陆百万心中水涨船高，为此，他看到了聚仙楼的希望了。
“去，吩咐小唐，再做一份！”陆百面向老秃驴，吩咐道。
老秃驴应了声，正欲去内院时，唐琳从内院出来了，她也听到了陆百万的话，“还没有正式开门做生意之前，今儿个，就只做一份了，客人若是想继续吃到这份饭菜，等我们酒楼正式开门做生意那天再来吧！”
content_en:
This taste is simply unique in the world!
In the dining hall.
Seeing the old bald donkey coming up with a big watermelon, the young man who was drinking tea stared with almond-shaped eyes and said, "Pfft--" Then, a mouthful of tea spurted out, spraying the face of Lu Wanwan across from him.
Lu Wanwan stared blankly with his eyes blank, and then wiped the tea from his face with his sleeve.
But at this moment, the old bald donkey had already put the watermelon on the dining table.
Seeing that there was only one watermelon, a pair of chopsticks and a spoon, Lu Wanwan's face immediately darkened, and black lines appeared. He felt like he was being tricked. He looked up at the old bald donkey and scolded: "What are you doing bringing a watermelon out?"
The old bald donkey replied: "It's Miss Tang's order!"
Lu Wanwan, who was still unaware of the situation, was so angry that his face turned green and white, and ordered the old bald donkey, "Go and call that stinky girl out for me, how unreasonable!"
"No," the young man stopped Lu Wanwan's order and faced the old bald donkey, "Tell me, why are you bringing a watermelon to the table? I wonder if I want to eat fried rice with wine and fruit flavor? What do you mean?"
Miss Tang had warned her before that as soon as the watermelon was put on the table, she would be scolded all over. Thinking about it now, Old Bald Donkey couldn't help but admire Tang Lin's ability to predict what would happen next.
Following Tang Lin's instructions, the old bald donkey straightened his back, showed his most energetic side, and explained to Lu Wanwan and the young man: "Boss, the meal this guest ordered has been served, and it's this watermelon!"
Lu Wanwan had another dark look on his face. He wanted to get up and slap the old bald donkey in the face, "Look, is this the meal the guest wants? Don't you know this is watermelon?"
"Boss, you misunderstood!" The old bald donkey laughed fearlessly, then bent down and covered the watermelon.
The appetizing aroma immediately attracted everyone's attention, and they all gathered around the dining table to watch.
The little fat man looked at the rich fried rice in the watermelon and smacked his lips. His mouth was already watering with greed, and his hands were rubbing together restlessly. He was tempted by the delicious food in front of him, "It looks good, and it tastes delicious!"
Everyone's mouths and hands are ready to move, including Lu Wanwan himself,
At this moment, with the young man's nimble hands, when Lu Wanwan stretched out his hand, she moved the plate in front of her, picked up the chopsticks and spoon, and began to eat the watermelon.
Next, Lu Wanwan and several of his guys, except for the old bald donkey, were all salivating at the sight of the young man devouring the food, seemingly never having enough to eat.
After a while, the entire food in the watermelon was gone. The young man looked up at the old bald donkey with dissatisfaction and asked, "Is there any more?"
"Uh," the old bald donkey was stunned for a moment. After reacting, he asked, "Are you satisfied with this meal, sir?"
The young man patted the dining table and gave a thumbs up, "Satisfied, very satisfied. Not only did I eat fried rice that was full of color and flavor, but I also saw how watermelon is used to pack the fried rice. In this way, all the flavor will not be lost, and the fried rice is mixed with the watermelon flavor. This taste... well... is simply unique in the world!"
Being able to receive this compliment from the young man, Tang Lin's worth suddenly rose in Lu Wanwan's heart. For this reason, he saw hope in Juxian Tower.
"Go and tell Xiao Tang to make another one!" Lu Bai faced the old bald donkey and ordered.
The old bald donkey responded and was about to go to the inner courtyard when Tang Lin came out of the inner courtyard. She also heard Lu Wanwan's words, "Before we officially open for business, we will only make one serving today. If our guests want to continue to eat this meal, please come back on the day when our restaurant officially opens for business!"
